ops.en: THE FRAME. va-yomer YHWH el-moshe VE-EL-AHARON be-ERETZ MITZRAYIM — the statute-book opens with both brothers addressed IN THE LAND (the readings on Torah spoken outside the Land — named-only; the Kitzur's juxtaposition: the brothers beside the month-command — 'the testimony of the new moon is valid from relatives like Moses and Aaron,' named): the machine notes the genre-shift the letter marks wi…

THE CALENDAR [EX12-10 CROWN]. HA-CHODESH ha-ze lakhem ROSH CHODASHIM — 'THIS MONTH is for you the HEAD of months': the Torah's first commandment to the nation — and the verse carries its own arithmetic (VERIFIED/asserted): THREE month-words (tokens one, five, nine) with exactly THREE words between each — the Kitzur's grid: the intercalation-court's threes, Nisan's triple crown (kings, festivals, m…

THE COUNT. ve-im-YIMAT ha-bayit — 'if the house be too LITTLE': the statute's first case-law (the small house pooled with its neighbor — the rite scales by souls, not walls); ish LEFI OKHLO takhosu — 'each man ACCORDING TO HIS EATING you shall count': and the Kitzur's cipher lands exact (asserted at the build): ish-lefi-okhlo = AKHAL KE-ZAYIT (488 = 488) — 'if he ate an OLIVE'S WORTH, he has disch…

THE SPECS. SE TAMIM zakhar ben-shana — 'UNBLEMISHED, male, a year old': the offering-grammar debuts in the nation's first rite (tamim — the wholeness-word of Noah and Abraham now a specification: the corpus notes the word's career from character to checklist); min-ha- KEVASIM u-min-ha-IZIM — sheep or goats, either kind valid: the machine files the tolerance inside the precision (species free, age …

THE KEEPING. ve-haya lakhem le-MISHMERET — 'for a KEEPING' (the guard-word on the lamb four days — the mishmeret-noun's first statute; 12:42's night-of-watchings will return its root doubled); ve-SHACHATU oto KOL QEHAL adat-yisrael — 'the WHOLE ASSEMBLY shall slaughter it': the verb is singular-collective (the readings: all Israel one slaughterer — named-only); BEN HA-ARBAYIM — 'BETWEEN THE EVENIN…

THE MEAL [EX12-09 CROWN]. ve-AKHLU et-ha-basar ba-layla ha-ze... al- merorim YOKHLUHU — the verse OPENS with eating and CLOSES with eating (asserted; the Kitzur: 'two eatings — the pesach's and the festival-offering's'); and the eat-it word's census lands the Masorah's file EXACT (VERIFIED): here, the SECOND PESACH's identical bitter-herbs clause (Num 9:11 — the make-up month already in the letter…

THE ROAST. al-tokhlu mimenu NA u-vashel MEVUSHAL — 'not RAW, nor BOILED at all': the double-negative fence around one permitted mode (fire-roast whole — head, legs, inwards: the animal unbroken, 12:46's bone-law armed); and the boiled-word Torah-UNIQUE (asserted), its only Scripture-twin the sons of Eli demanding 'I will not take BOILED flesh from you' (1 Sam 2:15, named — the Kitzur: 'they profan…

THE LEFTOVER [EX12-05 CROWN]. ve-lo-totiru mimenu ad-boqer — 'leave NONE until morning'; ve-HA-NOTAR mimenu... ba-esh tisrofu — 'what REMAINS you shall burn': and the remainder-word is written LEAN exactly here and nowhere else (VERIFIED): every other notar-form in the Torah FULL (the six of Leviticus, the ordination's, the hail's leavings — asserted): the leftover-word spelled THINNEST at the ver…

THE POSTURE [EX12-06; EX12-07; EX12-08 CROWNS]. ve-KHAKHA tokhlu oto — 'and THUS shall you eat it': the thus-word Torah-UNIQUE (VERIFIED), its Scripture-twin EZRA'S shaking-out oath (Neh 5:13, named — 'a miracle was fit for Ezra's days as for Moses', the sin forfeited it), and around its accent the five-authority stress-trial (Radak's unique-end-stressed against Provencali's pair-front- stressed w…

THE PASS-THROUGH. ve-AVARTI ve-eretz mitzrayim ba-layla ha-ze — 'I will PASS THROUGH... in this night' (the readings' I-and-no- messenger, named-only — the Haggada's own gloss on the first person); ve-hiketi khol-BEKHOR — the strike-forecast joins 11:4-5's midnight deck; u-ve-khol ELOHE mitzrayim eese SHEFATIM — 'on all the GODS of Egypt I will do JUDGMENTS': the Jehu-wire RECEIPTED (exo_10 armed …

THE PROMISE. ve-haya HA-DAM lakhem LE-OT — 'the blood shall be for you A SIGN' (the ot-word's career: the bow Gen 9, the mila Gen 17, the bush-mountain 3:12, now the threshold — the corpus's sign- ledger); ve-raiti et-ha-dam U-FASACHTI alekhem — 'I will see the blood and PASS OVER you': the pass-verb debuts (the rite's own name- verb performing in the promise; the readings' protect-reading named- …

THE MEMORIAL. ve-haya ha-yom ha-ze lakhem LE-ZIKARON — 'for a MEMORIAL': the day itself made a sign (the zikaron-class debuts in statute); ve-CHAGOTEM oto CHAG la-YHWH — 'you shall FEAST it as a FEAST': 10:9's chag-YHWH claim (the feast Moses invoked to empty Egypt) now legislated — the corpus notes the receipt: what was a negotiating position is a perpetual command; le-dorotekhem CHUQAT OLAM — 'a…

THE WEEK [EX12-02 CROWN; EX12-03 CROWN]. shivat yamim MATZOT tokhelu — 'seven days you shall eat UNLEAVENED BREAD' (the matzot-word FULL here in-stream, with the ZOHAR's lean reading dual-tracked — 'the Masorah and our books dispute both,' MS: the mystical minority filed unmerged); akh ba-yom HA-RISHON tashbitu SEOR — 'on the FIRST day REMOVE leaven' (the Kitzur's cipher asserted: AKH = CHOVA, 21 …

THE CONVOCATIONS. u-va-yom ha-rishon MIQRA-QODESH u-va-yom ha-shevii miqra-qodesh — the holy-convocation term debuts (Leviticus 23's whole calendar-grammar seeded here); kol-melakha lo-yease vahem — the work-ban's first festival form — AKH asher yeakhel le-khol- nefesh — with the FOOD-EXCEPTION built in ('only what every soul eats, that alone may be done'): the machine files the festival-day's leg…

THE GUARD. u-SHEMARTEM et-HA-MATZOT — 'you shall GUARD the unleavened bread' (the tzadi DAGESHED, MS, asserted; the readings' guard-the-mitzvot double-reading named-only); ki BE-ETZEM HA-YOM ha- ze HOTZETI et-TZIVOTEKHEM — 'on THIS VERY DAY I brought out your HOSTS': the very-day formula and the hosts-word BOTH spoken in the perfect BEFORE the event (the letter dates the law from inside the night …

THE DATES [EX12-03; EX12-04 CROWNS]. BA-RISHON be-arbaa asar yom — 'IN THE FIRST [month]': the first-word LEAN (VERIFIED — the second of the Torah's two lean firsts, both this chapter; the Kitzur: 'six hours one may keep leaven' — the dropped vav made law); ba-erev tokhlu MATZOT — and the matzot-word LEAN (VERIFIED EXACT): one of the Masorah's FOUR lean stations, its sign transmitted HERE — 12:18,…

THE SOJOURNER. shivat yamim SEOR lo yimatze be-vatekhem — the leaven-ban moves from eating to PRESENCE ('shall not be FOUND' — the search-law's seed); BA-GER u-ve-EZRACH ha-aretz — 'among the SOJOURNER and among the NATIVE': the ger enters the corpus's statute-language (the first law that names the stranger as bound alongside the citizen — 12:48-49's full equality armed): the machine notes the kar…

THE SEAL. kol-machmetzet lo tokhelu — the leavened-thing banned by name; be-khol MOSHVOTEKHEM tokhlu MATZOT — 'in ALL YOUR DWELLINGS': the dwellings-word closes the statute-block (the corpus notes the echo: the light was in their MOSHAVOT at 10:23 — the word of the spared houses now the word of the commanded ones): the machine seals the matza-deck; the statute-frame's first half (12:1-20, the divi…

THE RELAY. va-yiqra moshe le-khol-ZIQNE yisrael — the ELDERS again (3:16's institution, the corpus's standing relay-organ); MISHKHU u-qechu lakhem tzon — 'DRAW OUT and take': Moses' own push to the nation (the card pops with the divine one at 12:28) — and the draw- word carries MS's most personal note (asserted): the shin on its sheva ALONE, the METEG in the mem — 'precise books are CONFUSED about…

THE APPLICATION [EX12-11 CROWN]. agudat EZOV — the hyssop-bundle (the humble herb's career opened: the leper's rite, the red heifer — named-only); ve-higatem el-HA-MASHQOF ve-el-shte HA-MEZUZOT — and the ORDER INVERTS the command (VERIFIED both ways: 12:7 doorposts- then-lintel, here lintel-then-doorposts; the census of the lintel- word exactly the chapter's three): the Kitzur — 'to say: IF HE CHA…

THE PASS-OVER [EX12-12 CROWN]. ve-avar YHWH li-negof et-mitzrayim — the pass-through restated with the strike-infinitive framing the verse at both ends (li-negof... li-negof); u-FASACH YHWH al-ha- petach — 'the LORD will PASS OVER the opening'; ve-LO YITEN ha- mashchit lavo — 'and will NOT LET the destroyer come in': and the not-let frame stands exactly THREE times in the Torah (VERIFIED, all thre…

THE STATUTE. u-shemartem et-ha-davar ha-ze LE-CHAQ lekha u-le- VANEKHA ad-OLAM — 'a statute for you and FOR YOUR SONS, FOREVER': the perpetuity-formula in its shortest form — the machine notes the sons-word pivoting the statute toward the next verse's landing (the rite is being addressed to generations before the first night has happened): the answer-script's ground prepared.

THE LAND-CLAUSE. ve-haya ki-TAVOU el-ha-aretz asher yiten YHWH lakhem KA-ASHER DIBER — 'when you COME to the land... AS HE HAS SPOKEN': the promise-ledger cited inside the statute (the as-He- spoke formula pointing at the patriarch-deeds — the corpus's oldest account re-invoked as the rite's future venue); u-shemartem et-HA- AVODA ha-zot — 'this SERVICE': the avoda-word (the slavery-word of 1:14 a…

THE QUESTION. ve-haya ki-yomru alekhem BENEKHEM — 'when YOUR SONS say to you: WHAT IS THIS SERVICE TO YOU?': the child's question written into the statute — 10:2's story-clause (tell in the ears of your son) RECEIPTED as law: the corpus files the Haggada's second charter (the question of the son who says la-khem, 'to YOU' — the readings' four-sons grid, named-only): the machine pushes the ANSWER-S…

THE SCRIPT. va-amartem ZEVACH-PESACH hu la-YHWH — the commanded answer verbatim (asher PASACH al-bate vene-yisrael... ve-et-BATENU HITZIL — 'and OUR houses He rescued': the script speaks in the first person of a generation not yet out — the seder's law of as-if-you- yourself seeded in the grammar; the pe of be-NAGPO DAGESHED, MS, checked); va-YIQOD ha-am va-yishtachavu — 'and the people BOWED': th…

THE COMPLIANCE. va-yelkhu VA-YAASU bene-yisrael — 'and they went AND DID': the lamb-command's card POPS on the compliance-formula (ka- asher tziva YHWH et-moshe ve-aharon — the exact do-as-commanded seal, the corpus's go-and-do class in its fullest form).

THE SECOND DOING [the Kitzur's pair]. KEN ASU — 'SO THEY DID': the verse carries TWO do-verbs (asserted: va-yaasu... asu) — and the Kitzur reads the doubling as the night's two rites: 'TWO DOINGS — one for the PESACH and one for the MILA' (the circumcision the ciphers have been pricing: lakhem = ha-mila, min-ha-dam = deme mila — the night's second blood): Moses' relay-card pops with the divine car…

THE STRIKE. va-yehi BA-CHATZI ha-layla — 'at HALF of the night' (the half-word Torah-UNIQUE here, VERIFIED at the build; the Kitzur's three named: Ruth's trembling midnight, Samson's Gaza gates — 'the Holy One does miracles for the righteous at half-night'; 11:4 said ABOUT midnight, the deed says AT the half — the readings on the rounding, named-only): va-YHWH HIKA khol-bekhor — the EVENT: the ten…

THE CRY. va-YAQAM paro LAYLA — 'and Pharaoh ROSE at night' (the king who commanded morning-meetings wakes at midnight; the readings: he himself goes searching for Moses — named-only); va-tehi TZEAQA GEDOLA — the GREAT CRY lands: the third and last station of the Torah's great-cry file (asserted: ESAU'S cry at the stolen blessing Gen 27:34, the forecast 11:6, the payment here — the account the read…

THE CAKES. va-yofu et-ha-batzeq... UGOT MATZOT — 'CAKES of unleavened bread' (the cakes-word LEAN-OF-LEAN, Torah-unique so spelled — asserted, with the Ramah's file: Sarah's cakes Gen 18:6 and the manna's Num 11:8 both fuller, the copyists' lean-lean manna- variant called 'an ERROR the Masorah disputes'; the gimel SOFT, MS): the matza-week's future memory baked as fact; ki GORSHU mi-mitzrayim — 'f…

THE NUMBER. u-MOSHAV bene yisrael... SHELOSHIM shana ve-ARBA MEOT shana — 'THIRTY years and FOUR HUNDRED years': the sojourn-total stated (the readings' full accounting — the four hundred of the covenant counted from Isaac, the four-thirty from the decree, named- only and dual-tracked: the corpus does not adjudicate chronologies, it files the letter's two numbers side by side — Gen 15:13's four hu…

THE PAYMENT. va-yehi MI-QETZ sheloshim shana ve-arba meot shana — 'at the END' (the qetz-word on the count — and the corpus's cipher- receipt lands: exo_06 filed the Kitzur's MI-QOTZER ruach = 430 — the shortness-of-spirit word carrying the sojourn's own number in its letters: the breath that could not hear at 6:9 was already counting to this verse); va-yehi BE-ETZEM HA-YOM ha-ze — 'on THIS VERY D…

THE WATCHING [EX12-15 CROWN]. LEL SHIMURIM hu la-YHWH — 'a night of WATCHINGS is it to the LORD' — and the watchings-word stands TWICE IN THIS ONE VERSE (VERIFIED in-verse: the Masorah's pair is the verse's own two): His watching and theirs, the guarded and the guarding — the Kitzur: 'the Holy One DIVIDED the night of the fifteenth: HALF for the going-out of Egypt, HALF for the redemption to come'…

THE ORDINANCE. va-yomer YHWH el-moshe ve-aharon — the statute-frame returns (the chapter ring-composed: law, night, law); ZOT CHUQAT HA- PASACH — 'THIS is the ORDINANCE of the passover': the admission-deck pushed (kol-ben-NEKHAR lo-yokhal bo — 'no FOREIGNER shall eat of it': the table fenced the same night the ger was written in — the machine files the double motion: 12:19 opened the law to the st…

THE GATE. ve-khol-EVED ish miqnat-KASEF — the bought servant; u-MALTA oto AZ yokhal bo — 'you shall CIRCUMCISE him; THEN he may eat': the mila-gate made explicit (the night's two bloods now statute: no pesach without the covenant-cut — the ciphers of 12:13 and 12:22 legislated): the machine files the ordinance's principle: the table's border is the covenant's border, not the household's.

THE FENCE. TOSHAV ve-SAKHIR lo-yokhal bo — 'a SETTLER and a HIRELING shall not eat': the five-word verse (no etnachta — the stream splits it at its strongest servant-stroke, the machine notes the miniature): residence and employment do not admit to the table — only the covenant does (12:44's gate beside 12:45's fence, the pair teaching by contrast): the deck's second clause filed.

THE BONE. be-VAYIT ECHAD yeakhel — 'in ONE HOUSE' (the one-word on the eating-place: the readings' one-fellowship, named-only); lo- totzi min-ha-basar CHUTZA — 'take none of the flesh OUTSIDE' (the outside-word Torah-unique, asserted — the Kitzur: 'OUTSIDE He was slaying and the destroyer barred within: therefore no flesh goes out' — the statute frozen from the night's own geography, with Isaiah's…

THE ALL. KOL-ADAT yisrael YAASU oto — 'ALL the congregation shall DO it': the five-word universal (the second no-etnachta miniature — command and community in one breath): no exempt class within the covenant (the deck's fences outward, this clause inward): the machine files the symmetry.

THE DOOR. ve-khi-YAGUR itkha GER ve-asa FESACH — 'when a SOJOURNER would DO a passover' (the pe of fesach SOFT — MS: 'there is no coming-from-afar here' — the accent-law's exception ruled; khol- zakhar's kaf soft beside it, both asserted); HIMOL lo khol-zakhar VE-AZ yiqrav — 'let every male be circumcised AND THEN he may draw near': the and-then word's Torah-pair (asserted: here and 'AND THEN thei…

ONE TORAH. TORA ACHAT yihye la-EZRACH ve-la-GER — 'ONE LAW for the native and for the sojourner': the Torah-word itself debuts as a counted noun (ONE — the equality-principle stated as arithmetic): the machine files the ordinance-deck's coda: the deck that opened with a fence (12:43) closes with a leveling — one night, one table, one law: the corpus's jurisprudence-verse, armed across the codes (L…

THE SECOND COMPLIANCE. va-YAASU kol-bene yisrael ka-asher tziva YHWH et-moshe VE-ET-aharon KEN ASU — the compliance-formula sounds again (12:28's twin with KOL added — 'ALL the sons of Israel': the universal clause of 12:47 echoed in the receipt): the ordinance-card POPS: the machine notes the chapter's discipline — every command- deck in the unit is either perpetual by class or receipted by formu…

THE BRINGING-OUT. va-yehi BE-ETZEM HA-YOM ha-ze — the very-day formula's third sounding (statute 12:17, hosts 12:41, now the event- seal); HOTZI YHWH et-bene yisrael me-eretz mitzrayim — 'the LORD BROUGHT OUT the sons of Israel' (asserted): the EVENT the book is named for — the hiphil of the going-out verb with the Name as subject (11:4's ani-yotze kept: He went out, and they were brought); AL-TZI…
